title: Useme Sunrise
prompt: dance pop in the style of the band big sis
description: A bright, percussion-led dance-pop cut that grows out of a chopped 'useme' vocal hook over an AkaiLinn breakbeat and pumping supersaw pads. It keeps opening up section after section — hats getting busier, the vocal stutter rearranging, dub stabs widening into the delay — for an uplifting, slightly raw continuous build with no real comedown until the outro.
code:
setcpm(120/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("useme").chop(8).slice(8, "0 ~ 2 ~ 4 ~ 5 7").speed("<1 1 1.5 1>").gain(0.7).lpf(perlin.range(500, 1600).slow(7)).delay(".4:.18:.55").room(0.3),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] ~ [ab2,c3,eb3,g3] ~>").s("supersaw").lpf(perlin.range(400, 1100).slow(9)).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.3, 0.9)).attack(0.4).release(0.6).room(0.4)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ [~ bd]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.9),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.55).cut(1).pan(perlin.range(0.3, 0.7)),
    s("useme").chop(8).slice(8, "0 2 ~ 4 5 ~ 7 2").speed("<1 1.5 1 0.5>").gain(0.72).crush(8).delay(".4:.16:.5").lpf(perlin.range(800, 2200).slow(5)),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("supersaw").lpf(900).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.28, 0.95)).attack(0.3).release(0.5).room(0.35)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.95),
    s("cp").bank("AkaiLinn").struct("~ 1 ~ 1").gain(0.8).delay(".3:.12:.4"),
    s("hh*3").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.5).cut(1).sometimesBy(0.3, x => x.speed(1.5)),
    s("oh").bank("AkaiLinn").struct("~ ~ ~ 1").gain(0.5).cut(1),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3]> ~ <[ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(perlin.range(700, 1800).slow(6)).shape(0.3).gain(0.7).delay(".35:.18:.5"),
    note("0 2 4 5 7 5 4 2").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.62).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.4)).delay(".3:.1:.45"),
    note("<c2 c2 ab1 g1>").s("triangle").gain(0.8).lpf(600),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("supersaw").lpf(1100).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.3, 0.9)).attack(0.2).release(0.45).room(0.3)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("useme").chop(8).slice(8, "0 ~ 5 ~ 7 ~ 4 ~").speed("<1 0.5 1.5 1>").gain(0.75).crush(7).vowel("<a e o>").delay(".5:.2:.6").room(0.45).lpf(perlin.range(900, 2600).slow(4)),
    note("<[c4,eb4,g4] [ab3,c4,eb4] [bb3,d4,f4] [g3,bb3,d4]>").s("piano").gain(0.6).room(0.5).delay(".4:.15:.4"),
    note("<c2 ab1 bb1 g1>").s("triangle").gain(0.7).lpf(500)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(1.0).every(8, x => x.ply("<1 1 1 2>")),
    s("cp").bank("AkaiLinn").struct("~ 1 ~ 1").gain(0.85).delay(".3:.12:.4"),
    s("hh*3").bank("AkaiLinn").gain(0.52).cut(1).sometimesBy(0.35, x => x.speed(2)).swingBy(0.12, 8),
    s("oh").bank("AkaiLinn").struct("~ ~ 1 ~ ~ ~ ~ 1").gain(0.5).cut(1),
    s("useme").chop(8).slice(8, "0 2 4 7 5 4 2 0").speed("<1 1.5 1 2>").gain(0.74).crush(8).delay(".35:.14:.5").lpf(perlin.range(1000, 2800).slow(5)),
    note("~ <[c3,eb3,g3]> ~ <[ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("sawtooth").lpf(perlin.range(900, 2200).slow(7)).shape(0.35).gain(0.7).delay(".35:.18:.5"),
    note("0 2 4 5 7 9 7 5").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.62).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.42)).every(4, x => x.rev()).delay(".3:.1:.45"),
    note("<c2 c2 ab1 g1>").s("triangle").gain(0.82).lpf(700),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("supersaw").lpf(1300).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.32, 0.95)).attack(0.15).release(0.4).room(0.3)
  )],
  [12, stack(
    s("useme").chop(8).slice(8, "0 ~ 2 ~ 4 ~ ~ ~").speed("<1 1.5>").gain(0.68).delay(".5:.2:.6").room(0.4).lpf(perlin.range(600, 1400).slow(6)),
    note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3] [ab2,c3,eb3,g3]>").s("supersaw").lpf(800).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.28, 0.8)).attack(0.5).release(0.7).room(0.45),
    note("<c2 ab1>").s("triangle").gain(0.7).lpf(450)
  )]
)
